To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the composites with 14 and 21 vol% YAG were the most suitable for application as solid electrolyte in IT – SOFC due to the highest electrical conductivity and the lowest electrical resistivity.
YAG nanoparticles were obtained in the form of powder and successfully incorporated with alumina matrix to form a composite material with high electrical conductivity.
the electrical conductivity of the composites increases with increasing volume fraction of YAG and the highest conductivity was obtained for the composite containing 28 vol% of YAX.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of a new type of solid electrolyte for SOFCs, which is a composite material with the high relative density and the highest electrical conductivity of the grain boundary (κg) at the same temperature.
a possibility of the use of YAG in the form of a composite with the ceramic matrix in order to increase electrical conductivity of the solid electrolyte for intermediate-temperature SOFC.
the preparation of YAG powder and composites of YAG in alumina.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the addition of YAG particles to the Al2O3 matrix has resulted in an increase of electrical conductivity.
the AYX_21 composite with the highest electrical conductivity of 1.5×10-1 Ω-1cm at 700 o C can be used as an electrolyte for IT-SOFC.
YAG addition into the alumina matrix leads to the improvement of the electrical conductivity of grain and grain boundary of the composite.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the addition of YAG to alumina matrix leads to the formation of a continuous conductive path and to the increase of electrical conductivity of the composite.
the electrical conductivity of the composites was strongly influenced by the volume fraction of YAG.
it was found that YAG particles in alumina matrix form a conductive path, what is very important for the improvement of the electrical conductivity of the composites.
The main takeaway from our work is that
YAG can be successfully used as a solid electrolyte for intermediate-temperature solid oxide fuel cell.
the composites with high relative density can be obtained by mixing commercial powder with YAG powder.
the addition of YAG to the matrix of alumina leads to an improvement of the electrical conductivity of composites.
